statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease
The diagnosis codes are I47.1, I25.10, I49.5
The procedure code billed is CPT 93271
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
Cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary to capture arrhythmic episodes during daily activities
The symptoms are intermittent and require correlation of clinical events with underlying rhythm disturbances
